competitors.name: Conagra Brands / Celeste
competitors.action: Conagra Brands said it is exiting the Celeste frozen pizza business as an early step in a company-wide SKU-complexity review. The exit reduced first-quarter net sales by approximately 15 basis points, but Conagra expects it to improve margins and free resources for brands and categories where it has greater scale and growth potential.

competitors.name: J.M. Smucker / Uncrustables and frozen handheld competitors
competitors.action: Food Business News reported that non-breakfast frozen handheld entrees were the only frozen-entree subcategory to grow during the 52 weeks ended Aug. 9, increasing 2.6% to $4.6 billion while total frozen dinners and entrees declined in dollars and units. Uncrustables reached $1 billion in fiscal 2026 and added more than 3 million households, while Welch's, Jams and Rudi's are competing with larger, high-protein or dietary-positioned frozen sandwiches.

trends.topic: Large frozen portfolios pruning low-scale legacy pizza SKUs
trends.magnitude: Conagra's Celeste exit created an approximately 15-basis-point first-quarter sales headwind; the company expects the decision to be margin-accretive and says most benefits from its broader SKU review should build over the next 12 to 18 months.
trends.context: This is a direct frozen-pizza portfolio exit, not merely a weak quarterly result. It signals reduced tolerance for legacy brands that add manufacturing and reset complexity without sufficient scale or growth. Real Dough's buyer case should therefore lead with a distinct consumer job, repeat ordering, margin contribution and a disciplined SKU architecture rather than assortment breadth alone.

trends.topic: Portable frozen handhelds outperforming full frozen meals
trends.magnitude: Non-breakfast frozen handheld-entree sales increased 2.6% to $4.6 billion in the 52 weeks ended Aug. 9, while total frozen dinners and entrees fell 0.3% in dollars to $13.8 billion and 1.1% in units.
trends.context: The figures cover the broader frozen-entree market rather than pizza specifically, but the divergence is operationally useful: shoppers are rewarding portable, portioned formats with convenience, protein or dietary cues while full-meal units soften. Real Dough should frame premium pizza's convenience and portion value explicitly and watch whether handheld formats take more freezer space during resets.

market_data.metric: Conagra frozen portfolio and Celeste exit
market_data.value: Refrigerated & Frozen organic net sales declined 1.6% in fiscal Q1; company frozen dollar consumption declined 0.7% and volume declined 0.5%
market_data.change: Celeste exit represented an approximately 15-basis-point Q1 net-sales headwind and is expected to be accretive to margins

market_data.metric: Frozen handheld versus frozen dinner and entree performance
market_data.value: $4.6 billion in non-breakfast frozen handheld-entree sales, up 2.6%, for the 52 weeks ended Aug. 9, 2026
market_data.change: Total frozen dinner and entree sales fell 0.3% to $13.8 billion, with units down 1.1%, according to Circana data reported by Food Business News
